title: Battle of Aliaga
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Aliaga", at revision 1370431675, opens: "The Battle of Aliaga was fought on September 4–5, 1897, between the Philippine revolutionaries of Nueva Ecija and the Spanish forces of Governor General Primo de Rivera." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4870262, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1897 battle in Nueva Ecija, Philippines". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
